name: The Doll and the Spider
source:
Carolyn has forgotten her doll outside in the backyard and is now deep asleep. With the upcoming witch's hour, her doll worries that she might not be able to find a way to return inside the house to protect Carolyn. To her luck, the brother's pet tarantula appears after a hunt. With some persuasion, the tarantula reluctantly agrees to carry her back to Carolyn, hopefully before it is the witch's hour.

[From [url=https://sunlit-dreamer.itch.io/the-doll-and-the-spider]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
卡罗琳把自己的洋娃娃忘在后院，现在已经熟睡。女巫时刻即将到来，洋娃娃担心自己可能找不到回屋的方法，无法保护卡罗琳。幸运的是，哥哥养的狼蛛捕猎归来。经过一番劝说，狼蛛不情愿地答应把她带回卡罗琳身边，希望能赶在女巫时刻到来前。

[来源：[url=https://sunlit-dreamer.itch.io/the-doll-and-the-spider]itch.io[/url]]
